frontmatter.title: The Self-Hosted Runner Risk: Why the pull_request_target Flaw is Even Worse
frontmatter.subheading: When an attacker can run code on your own infrastructure, the damage goes far beyond just a compromised repository.
frontmatter.excerpt: Discover the heightened risks of the `pull_request_target` vulnerability on self-hosted runners, from lateral movement in your cloud to cryptomining.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
